_comment: Cards that exist only for the no-maximum-hand-size test (tests/unit/players/test_no_maximum_hand_size.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_sea_gate` is Sea Gate Restoration's second sentence on its own, on a one-mana sorcery so the test can cast it from a single Island. `t_hand_freedom_for_all` names every player, which is the spec's other end.

cards.name: Test Sea Gate
cards.oracle_text: You have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Test Hand Freedom For All
cards.oracle_text: Each player has no maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
